scope: Signed FV-face energy and Noether-charge transport from saved quasistatic-chi seed evolutions; no field advancement. K0 subtraction is a control difference, not automatic modal or radiative power.
allocation: Same positive half-link energy as pair_axisym_v2.c; strict cell-centre spherical mask, summing all oriented interior cut faces.

conventions.E_face_i_to_j: sum_a fac_a Cij (qai-qaj)(vai+vaj), fac=1 for complex Cartesian components and1/2 chi
conventions.Q_face_i_to_j: -2 Cij Im(Psi_i* Psi_j)-4 Cij Im(X_i* X_j)
conventions.sampling: 10 natural-time-unit snapshots, trapezoidal integrals; numerical reconstruction error is measured, not assumed small.
conventions.signed_charge: Positive signed Q flux is not by itself a particle mass or direction classifier if opposite charges exist.
